reference_change.summary: Delete the documented cratebox/compat require alias, bump the Ruby gem to 2.0.0, and document migration to cratebox/client.
reference_change.rationale: Retire the duplicate supported loader so the package maintains one canonical entrypoint.
reference_change.limitations: The client class and its methods do not move; downstream require strings cannot be updated by this patch.
reference_change.breaking_changes: Existing require "cratebox/compat" callers stop loading; replace it with require "cratebox/client" before adopting version 2.0.
